title: Open research data implementation workshare
scope: Configure two approved OpenAlex works queries for a named research or library use case; agree fields, filters, source period, account budget and publication permissions.
Install the retained researcher workspace in one customer-controlled environment, with original query revisions, complete cursor/page records and source coverage.
Set up useful record review, notes and selections; author/institution/topic/funder summaries; supplied-field and duplicate reporting; and a later-capture comparison.
Integrate one reviewed metadata-service route or agreed CSV/JSON research output interface using the existing maintained operator/client workflow.
Deliver the exact source pages, complete selected research editions, original review history and reports, bibliography/CSV/JSON outputs, the working receiver and a newly reopened private workspace.
Complete two consolidated review/correction cycles, one 90-minute engineer/operator handover and a written operating and recovery guide.
inputs: A named project owner and researcher/reviewer, the two research questions and what useful output will be accepted.
Approved OpenAlex query or institutional identifiers, selected fields/date range and an agreed record envelope; the customer's provider account if authenticated acquisition is selected.
One Linux/Node deployment environment with appropriate private storage and the customer-controlled service or output destination.
The selected access and delivery model; any native merchant terms and signer/facilitator configuration stay with the authorized customer/operator.
Consolidated reviewer feedback within one business day during the agreed delivery window.
acceptance: Each source request and received page can be traced to the selected query revision; coverage, missing fields, duplicates and any interrupted acquisition remain visible.
Review decisions and useful research outputs survive restart; the later edition comparison retains the original IDs and before/after metadata.
An engineer receives the complete exported edition into a new private workspace and reopens the original query, page bytes and review decisions.
The agreed customer-facing service/output works with the designated recipient and the operator can repeat the documented refresh, review, export and recovery procedure.

warranty.scope: Correction of defects in the delivered implementation
warranty.response: Initial response within two business days, followed by diagnosis and an agreed correction date

care.scope: Delivered workflow configuration, source-field changes and monthly retained-edition/recovery review

boundaries: Cottage Labs retains the institutional relationship, research interpretation and customer infrastructure. Provider charges, hosting and third-party subscriptions stay in the customer-approved account. Additional repositories, custom repository write-back, full-text acquisition/remediation, bibliometric research conclusions and extra cohorts receive a separate agreed scope.
